scripts.build-backend: node init && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build-client: node init && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.preview-client: npm run build-client & npm run preview --prefix client
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run backend" "npm run client"
scripts.build-all: node init && npm run build-backend & npm run build-client
scripts.install-all: npm i && concurrently "cd ./client & npm i" "cd ./backend & npm i"
